hook: A sandboxed app with no network still got online

beats.say: Researcher Tony Gorez found a sandboxed iOS or macOS app without network access can ask Apple's nsattributedstringagent service to fetch web content for it.
The service accepts every caller and renders HTML with WebKit, downloading whatever the markup points to. A test pulled back 9,300 bytes of JPEG.
He filed two reports with Apple in March 2026. Apple classed it as hardening rather than a vulnerability, and credited him in its September 2026 Safari and WebKit update.
